name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.110.0 — token-cost trims for Fable 5.1 seats: core § Session Execution (edit-don't-rewrite, act on enough information, no extras, batch calls) served by every shared-for list; shared-for gains init (no more whole-doctrine fail-open) and run-design (the delta /spec:run's Design stage loads; build/review stages skip their own shared-for); shared-genesis/shared-mocks --section slice one supplement section and both drivers print the slice per step, so the 50 KB / 23 KB supplements are never read whole; shared-for stops echoing frontmatter; the plugin description's changelog paragraphs are one line each. 7.109.0 — DEFAULT_TEST_GLOBS single-sourced in lib/host-config.js; the equality pin becomes a single-declaration pin. 7.108.0 — genesis BRIEF drops its tokens.css precondition and Dissents check; its next: line names APPROVED.
